notes:
Pre-IPO STAR Market applicant (no stock code yet at the filing date); limited company founded 2014-11-07, converted to a joint-stock company 2022-11-22, registered in the Lingang new area of the Shanghai FTZ. Business scope as the filing states it: 公司的主营业务为半导体 AMHS 相关设备、软件及成套系统的研发、生产和销售 — semiconductor fab automated material handling systems comprising 传送设备 (OHT transport, conveyor, AMR, lifter), 存储设备 (wafer/reticle stockers, overhead buffer units, near-tool buffers, electronic racks, tower stockers), 净化设备 (loadport purge) and the MCS control-software stack. It does NOT make wafer-process equipment, metrology, inspection or test equipment.
